textSegments: 80 PLUS Gold certified, fully modular PSU, compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications, and equipped with a native 12V-2x6 connector.

The fully modular Toughpower GT Snow series designed to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency and is compatible with ATX 3.1 standards. Its native PCIe 12V-2x6 (12+4 pin) modular interface efficiently powers PCIe 12+4 pin graphics cards. Backed by an extensive 5-year warranty, the Toughpower GT Snow series meets the needs of value-oriented users seeking a new power supply with reliable performance.

Toughpower GT Snow series is fully compatible with ATX 3.1 specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% efficiency at low load and complies with required power supply timing standards.
Toughpower GT Snow series comes with a PCIe 12V-2x6 connector to offer powerful and stable performance allowing the PSU to natively run next-generation GPUs.

The wattage marked on the PCIe 12+4-pin cable connector represents the recommended wattage (Ref. Intel design guideline). The bundled PCIe Gen 5.1 (12+4pin) cable connector of the Toughpower GT Snow 750W can deliver up to 600W for PCIe 12+4pin graphics cards.
1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the PCIe 12+4pin cable.
Ultra Quiet 120mm Hydraulic Bearing Fan with Smart Zero Fan
Featuring an 120mm Hydraulic Bearing Fan to keep friction at really low level. Designed with our Smart Zero Fan to adjust the fan speed and minimizes undesired noise.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail & High-Class Technologies

Powerful single +12V rail can properly deliver the power you need for the best compatibility. The use of LLC and DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.
Offers cable selection for users while powering the system at an advantageous voltage. Low-profile white cables make cable management easier, reduces clutter and increases airflow inside the chassis.

To protect the hardware, Toughpower GT Snow series is built with industry grade protections: OCP(Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP(Under Voltage Protection), OPP(Over Power Protection), SCP(Short Circuit Protection), OTP(Over Temperature Protection).
Toughpower GT Snow series saves energy through its high energy efficiency up to 90% and is certified to 80 PLUS® Gold.
